messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx and tail latency on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Severity: P1. Pager triggered. Link: https://incidents.redwood/1900123456

maria: acked. heading in. any CS tickets?

ben: seeing p95 jump to ~2.4s and p99 to ~6.8s. error spikes line up with a handful of very long seq requests (seq_len > 4096) from a single tenant.

ashok: grabbing logs and tailing the model pods, looks like decoder OOM bursts then retries -> 502s. Dumping a couple traces to gist.

olivia: customers on fastlane reported timeouts ~12:33-12:36. support pinged me, they saw 502 and retry loop.

maria: quick mitigation: can we mute alerts for the noisy pattern while we patch routing? I want to avoid paging on every retry flood. Propose squelch rule on alert `high_error_rate_v1_generate` for 10m while we hotpatch.

ben: +1 to squelch for 10m. also we should add an annotation to the runbook so future oncalls know why we suppressed.

ashok: patch ready — scaling decoder count for the affected pool, and adding a short-rate limit on >4096 seq_len in the routing layer. Will apply in 2m.

maria: doing the squelch now. will annotate runbook and link dashboard.

maria: (runs)

# mute alert for 10m
curl -X POST "https://alerts.redwood/api/mutes" -d '{"alert":"high_error_rate_v1_generate","duration":600,"reason":"noisy long-seq retry storm - hotpatch in flight","owner":"maria"}'

incident-bot: ALERT MUTE: `high_error_rate_v1_generate` muted for 10 minutes by maria.

olivia: confirmed support notified: https://support.redwood/tickets/INC-7712 (customers A, C reported).

ben: pushing a minimal alert rule tweak as a stopgap: bump threshold and add `for: 5m` so transient spikes don't page. PR: https://git.redwood/alerts/pulls/842

ashok: hotpatch applied to routing (rate-limit >4096). decoder pods scaled x3. metrics show immediate drop in retry count.

maria: updated runbook with annotations and link to the PR + dashboard. Runbook note: "If squelch applied during mitigation, add support ticket references and create follow-up action to revisit thresholds." Link: https://runbooks.redwood/alerts/high_error_rate_v1_generate?action=annotate&id=1900123456

ben: snippet of the alert rule change (from PR):
```
- alert: high_error_rate_v1_generate
  expr: job:errors:rate5m > 0.05
  for: 1m
+ alert: high_error_rate_v1_generate
+ expr: job:errors:rate5m > 0.12
+ for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

olivia: added owners to runbook section: "oncall -> maria, followup -> ben, support-contact -> olivia". Also created dashboard panel `seq_len_breakdown` (p50/p95/p99) and linked.

devex-bot: DEPLOY: alert-rule PR merged to prod by ben. CI green.

maria: handing off monitoring to olivia. I'll be reachable but stepping out for 20m. If errors drift back up please escalate to SRE rotation.

olivia: ack — watching charts, will escalate if p99 > 4s or error rate > 0.08 after the mute window.

incident-bot: MUTE EXPIRATION SCHEDULED: mute ends in 7m.

ben: created follow-up ticket: TKT-1904 "Re-evaluate error thresholds and dashboard panels after long-seq incident" and assigned to ben/maria.

maria: added post-incident checklist entry in the runbook: "1) validate thresholds with historical long-seq traffic 2) consider seq_len-specific alerting 3) add test to load harness"

ashok: quick note: we should also consider backing off retry logic at the proxy for seq_len>2048 to avoid amplification. filing short RFC.

olivia: handing back to maria in 20m if stable. leaving a final annotation in runbook with all links and timestamps. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks all — leaving final runbook note and closing this thread. We'll run a brief sync tomorrow to decide threshold defaults.
